backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two site changes and their associated files/components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup with extensive custom CSS variables for dark/rose-gold theme and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router, routes, SEO meta updates, and wraps pages with the shared layout.
Feature grid with flip-card animations showing six feature items with icons.
frontend/src/components/FinalCTA.tsx: Large CTA section with glowing background and buttons for joining, WhatsApp, and calling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with cinematic background, brand headline, description, and three CTAs.
Displays the academy’s address, phone number, a directions button, and an embedded Google Map.
Renders a grid of service cards and a CTA button that scrolls to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Implements a sticky header with desktop and mobile navigation using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/StickyButtons.ts: Provides fixed WhatsApp and phone call action buttons at the screen corners.
frontend/src/components/TransformationSe: Shows a transformation-themed section with benefits list and a WhatsApp CTA.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeSection.t: Introduces the academy with a welcome message and a call-now button.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Lists key reasons to choose the academy with icon cards and a trial session CTA.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to user identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity login, managing AuthClient creation, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file since no backend methods are available.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom theme utilities including dark theme variables and UI effects.
frontend/src/layouts/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout component with header, footer, main outlet, and sticky buttons wrapped in a dark-themed container.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with animated hero, story section, and values highlighting the fitness academy.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact methods, timings, and location info with animated UI sections.
frontend/src/pages/CoursesPage.tsx: Shows detailed course offerings and benefits with animated hero and grid sections.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the homepage from multiple section components like hero, services, and CTA.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: React 404 page showing error message and buttons to go home or navigate back with styled gradients.
frontend/src/seo/pageMeta.ts: Defines SEO metadata (title, description, keywords) for main routes including home, about, courses, contact, and 404.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings with added plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project state, including feature requests to remove a home page section and add a footer.
